text: Thanks, that screenshot answers it: the 13:20 account's routine DID start. It saw my live session (the lease I took at 16:56Z) and stood down on purpose ('another live interactive session holds the repo lease'), as designed, so it was not dead and I was wrong to call it a no-show. But it left no trace on the board, which would have made the new alert falsely fire tonight. Fixed: a routine that yields now leaves a 'stood down' note, the rotation check counts that as a run, and I marked today's 13:20 slot as explained so you won't get a false alert. Side effect to know: while you're chatting with me, the scheduled routines yield and don't run; I cover the analyst duty myself in that case.
